scripts.translation:

[Commander Joel]
If you wish to join the Illusion Investigation Corps, you're lacking in skills yet.
scripts.translation:

如果你想加入<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队，你的技能还不够。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Hello, I'm Joel, the Commander of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
你好，我是<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队的指挥官，乔尔。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Have you ever heard of or experienced illusions?
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
你听说过或者经历过<黑暗搜集者>幻觉吗？

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Until now, illusions have been discovered all over the world and are somewhat known to the public.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
迄今为止，<黑暗搜集者>幻觉已在世界各地被发现，公众对此也有一定了解。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
It is also used as a hunting ground for many adventurers because it is easy to obtain rare materials.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
由于容易获取稀有材料，它也被许多冒险者用作狩猎场。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Also, the monsters in Illusion are new monsters that have never been discovered before, and the monsters in Illusion are multiplying abnormally.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
此外，<黑暗搜集者>幻觉中的魔物是以前从未发现过的新魔物，而且它们的数量正在异常增加。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Despite many adventurers hunting the monsters that exist in Illusion to obtain materials, the reason for the very rapid recovery of the population has not been identified.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
尽管许多冒险者为了获取材料而狩猎<黑暗搜集者>幻觉中的魔物，但其数量恢复极快的原因仍未查明。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Our Illusion Investigation Team was organized to uncover the mystery of the Illusion, and first we decided to figure out the ecology of the monsters inside the Illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
我们的<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队是为了揭开<黑暗搜集者>幻觉的秘密而成立的，首先我们决定弄清其中魔物的生态。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
What we found was that all illusions are affected by dimensional rifts.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
我们发现，所有的<黑暗搜集者>幻觉都受到次元裂缝的影响。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
I've been speculating that it might be related to the dimensional rift for a long time, but with the results of this investigation, it's clear.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
我长期以来一直猜测这可能与次元裂缝有关，但根据这次调查的结果，这一点已经非常明确。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
There are still many adventurers visiting Illusion with a purpose, so the monster population is fortunately maintained.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
由于仍有许多冒险者带着目的前往<黑暗搜集者>幻觉，魔物数量得以维持，这是万幸。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If no one sets foot there, it's very dangerous because the monsters can go beyond saturation and invade other areas.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
如果没人踏足那里，魔物数量可能会超过饱和并入侵其他区域，那将非常危险。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
For that reason, the number of individuals is still being investigated, and one investigator is currently assigned to each illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
因此，目前仍在调查个体数量，每个<黑暗搜集者>幻觉都指派了一名调查员。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
And we're recruiting members with the ability to control the number of monsters inside Illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
我们正在招募能够控制<黑暗搜集者>幻觉内魔物数量的成员。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
And if you're an adventurer, you seem to be strong enough for that role...
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
而且，作为冒险者，你似乎足够强大，能够胜任这个角色...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Would you like to join the Illusion Investigation Team and join us in investigating illusions?
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
你愿意加入<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队，与我们一起调查<黑暗搜集者>幻觉吗？

scripts.text: I'm joining
scripts.translation: 我要加入

scripts.text: I'll think about it
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
It's very meaningful.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
这非常有意义。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Please think about it before you tell me.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
请考虑清楚后再告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Okay, you're welcome!!
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
好的，欢迎加入！！

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
The procedure is simple, please fill out the pledge here...
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
手续很简单，请在这里填写誓词...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Here... please sign this.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
请在这里... 签一下名。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
..
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
..

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
...
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Yes, with this you have become a member of the Illusionary Survey Corps, welcome again!
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
是的，至此你已成为<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队的成员，再次欢迎你！

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If you have time during your adventure, I would like you to stop by the Illusions located in various places and help me with the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
如果你在冒险期间有空，请前往各地出现的<黑暗搜集者>幻觉，协助我们进行调查。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
A dispatched investigator will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
派出的调查员会指引你。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Then I hope you have a nice day
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
那么，祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
I think the investigation will be much easier thanks to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
多亏了你，冒险者，我想调查工作会轻松许多。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
New illusions will appear again.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
新的<黑暗搜集者>幻觉还会再次出现。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Every new discovery takes a lot of time for us to adapt to it
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
每一次新发现都需要我们花费大量时间去适应。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
This investigation will at least help reduce that time.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
这项调查至少能帮助我们缩短这段时间。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Thank you and look forward to many more activities in the future.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 乔尔]
谢谢你，期待未来有更多活动。

你好，我是泽尼安，队伍的新成员。

[Member Zenian]
I've been paying attention to the phenomenon of dimensional rifts for a long time. Clearly, despite many subjugations, monsters are constantly appearing.

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
It has been proven that this phenomenon also occurs in illusions, so I decided to join the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:

已经证实这种现象也会发生在<黑暗搜集者>幻觉中，所以我决定加入<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
Good luck in the future!!
scripts.translation:
[成员 泽尼安]
祝你们未来一切顺利！！

你好！！

scripts.text:

Anyway... I'm in charge of investigating this place.
scripts.translation:

总之...我负责调查这个地方。

Have you heard about the investigation from Captain Joel? Adventurer, you have to completely hunt 100 monsters by yourself.

啊，今天的调查就到这里吧。

If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?

击杀100只任意种类的魔物，你愿意参与吗？

你平安回来了！

好吧...那么嗯...我得先观察一下魔物的刷新情况。

Leave the rest to me!! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:

剩下的交给我！！谢谢！！

scripts.translation:

你好~

[Elysia]

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

这里真的好冷啊...

I never thought I would be sent to such a dangerous place alone... I wanted to come with Jirocker...
scripts.translation:

没想到我会被单独派到这么危险的地方...我想和吉罗克一起来的...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Well, even if there was a Jirocker, he's a coward, so I'd be in a position to protect him...
scripts.translation:

嗯，就算有吉罗克在，他也是个胆小鬼，到时候反而得我来保护他...

[Elysia]
You pretended to be brave... but I already noticed

你假装很勇敢...但我已经看出来了

[Elysia]
Is Jirocker doing his investigation safely in the abandoned village? I'm worried.
scripts.translation:

吉罗克在废弃村庄里安全地进行调查吗？我很担心。

scripts.translation:

嗯...其实，现在不是担心吉罗克的时候，冒险者。你能帮帮我吗？

在激烈战斗时很容易统计魔物的数量。你呢？想不想参与这里的调查？

[Elysia]

scripts.translation:

[Elysia]

After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.

进入后，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I look forward to your hot hunting skills~~!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
期待你火热的狩猎技巧~~！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Ah, I think this should be enough for today!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
啊，我想今天这样就够了！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you come after tomorrow, you'll have something else to do~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
如果你明天再来，就有别的事情要做了~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Ah, nice to meet you!! Are you here today to help with the investigation??
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
啊，很高兴见到你！！你今天来是协助调查的吗？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Your help is the same as last time~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
你的帮助和上次一样~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
如果你能击杀100只任意种类的魔物，愿意参加吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Okay... I'll keep shivering in the cold...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
好吧...我会在寒冷中继续发抖...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Thank you
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
谢谢

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
进入后，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
那么请小心！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Kill 100 monsters regardless of type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Have you finished already? You've done it hotly as expected~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
你已经完成了吗？果然很厉害呢~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then I'll do the rest of the research for you~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
那么剩下的研究就交给我吧~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Thank you for your hard work. I hope we can meet again!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
谢谢你的辛苦工作。希望我们下次还能见面！！

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, Adventurer
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你好，冒险者

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我是来自<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查组的拉迪米尔。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我被派到了这么阴沉的地方，说实话，我很害怕

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'd like you to conduct the investigation together, but... you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我想邀请你一起进行调查，但是...你还没有加入调查组。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Would you like to do something meaningful with me?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你愿意和我一起做一些有意义的事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
If you are interested, please meet <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and join the Investigation Team and come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
如果你感兴趣，请去见<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>，普隆德拉的指挥官，加入调查组后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, Adventurer
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你好，冒险者

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我是来自<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查组的拉迪米尔。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我被派到了这么阴沉的地方，说实话，我很害怕

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
But I've always been interested in the phenomenon of illusion, and when the investigation team was founded, I actively applied for membership.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
但我一直对幻觉现象很感兴趣，当调查组成立时，我积极申请了加入。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Because nobody has figured it out yet
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
因为目前还没有人弄清楚它

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
It's just the beginning of the current investigation, but it's sure to be a great first step
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
这只是当前调查的开始，但肯定是一个伟大的第一步

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Therefore, fear can be overcome by will.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
因此，恐惧是可以被意志克服的。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Investigation preparations are complete, now I'm waiting for someone who can adjust the monsters' levels.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
调查准备工作已经完成，现在我在等待能调整魔物等级的人。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
How about you, why don't you participate in the investigation? You joined the investigation team for that, right?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你呢，为什么不参与调查呢？你加入调查组不就是为了这个吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'll stay here
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我会留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
很好。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
只要在这里击杀100只任意种类的魔物即可。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
The sooner the better.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
越快越好。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Then I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
那么，我就等你了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
That's it for today.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
今天就到这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
If the current trend, I think we can resume the investigation in a day or so. Please come then.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
按照目前的情况，我想大概一天左右就能恢复调查。到时候请过来。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你好，你今天来是为了协助调查吗？

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Please execute the operation as it was then.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
请按照之前的方式执行任务。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Would you like to participate in the task of killing 100 monsters of any type?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你要参与击杀100只任意种类魔物的任务吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
You acted meaninglessly, I'm disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你的行为毫无意义，我很失望。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Thank you
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Then I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
那么，我就等你了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
You came through quickly, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你来得真快，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
That makes it easier to work out the numbers.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
这样更容易计算数据了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I will finish the rest of the work soon and report it to the investigation team. Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我会尽快完成剩下的工作并向调查组汇报。感谢你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Hello!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我是来自<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查组的玛乔可~

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我真的很想被派到这里来，不过运气不错。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
这些该死的泰迪熊~~ 泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... But you haven't joined the investigation team yet...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
但我做不到... 我的力量不够... 不过你还没加入调查组...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
You can sign up by going to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera. Sign up and come here~
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
你可以去找<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>，普隆德拉的指挥官报名。报名后来这里~

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Hello!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我是来自<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查组的玛乔可~

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我真的很想被派到这里来，不过运气不错。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
这些该死的泰迪熊~~ 泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... He looks easy... but he's so strong...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
但我做不到... 我的力量不够... 他看起来很容易对付... 但他很强...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I thought I could do it all by myself... I took it too lightly... Huh...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我以为我可以一个人搞定... 我太轻视了... 唉...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I unknowingly and vigorously attacked and came back with a lot of beating... I almost died...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我不经意间猛烈攻击，结果被打得很惨... 差点死了...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I barely recovered... I think it's possible to investigate, but you look a little strong?
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我勉强恢复了... 我觉得调查是可能的，但你看起来有点强？

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Then help me... I need someone to take control of those vicious teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
那就帮帮我... 我需要有人来控制那些维舍斯泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
How about it? Do you want to join the investigation??
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
怎么样？你想加入调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Yes... I'm about to collapse after I've been here... Like a man without blood or tears...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
是的... 我在这里快撑不住了... 像个没有血和泪的男人...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Okay! Let's go!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
好的！我们走！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
去打败大约100只，然后回来，不管什么种类，看到就炸掉！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I... can't even move... Here... I'll wait...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我... 连动都动不了... 这里... 我会等着...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Well, no more today
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
好了，今天就到这里

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Come back after a day!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
一天后再回来！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Oh, nice to meet you! Welcome back!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
哦，很高兴见到你！欢迎回来！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
You must have come here because your body itches.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
你一定是因为身体发痒才来的吧。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Would you like to participate in the investigation work here again today??
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
你今天想再次参与这里的调查工作吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
What...then why did you come??
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
那...那你为什么还来？

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Sure, that's how it should be
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
没错，本来就该这样。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Regardless of the type, just beat 100 of them and bring them back.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
不管是什么种类，只要打倒100只并带回来就行。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'll be waiting for you, so hurry up!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我会在这里等你的，快点回来！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
去打败大约100只，然后回来，不管什么种类，看到就炸掉！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I've been waiting for you... finish quickly and come back...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我一直在等你...快点结束然后回来...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Um...but that's about it... um...yeah!! good!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
嗯...不过大概就是这样了...嗯...很好！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Leave the rest to me!! I'll report the results to the investigation team, now you can go and rest.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
剩下的交给我！！我会把结果汇报给调查组的，你现在可以去休息了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Thank you~~
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
谢谢~~

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我是奥里安，<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查组的契约工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Actually, it's not something I'm keen on...but I need the money...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
其实，我对这个并不太感兴趣...但我需要钱...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
如果你能帮我就好了...可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Uh, but you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
呃，但你还没有加入调查组。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
请向普隆德拉的指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申请入会，然后过来！！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我是奥里安，<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查组的契约工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
The Illumination Investigation Team is a newly formed organization, so it must have been a little understaffed. I saw an announcement that they would hire part-time contract workers.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查组是新成立的组织，所以人手肯定有点不足。我看到公告说他们会招募兼职契约工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Actually, I'm not interested in illusions... I'm busy making a living.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
其实，我对幻觉并不感兴趣...我正忙着谋生呢。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Huh... It's all about money, I'm going to buy a new set of clothes when I get paid.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
哈...都是为了钱，等拿到工资我就去买一套新衣服。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
But even that isn't easy... I've been waiting for an investigator like you to come because I think it's going to be very difficult on my own.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
但即使那样也不容易...我一直在等像你这样的调查员来，因为我觉得我一个人很难搞定。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
如果你能帮我就好了...可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Would you like to participate in this Illusion Investigation?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你想参加这次<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Ah... I finally found an investigator... Ah... I want money...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
啊...终于找到调查员了...啊...我想要钱...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Oh, thank you
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
噢，谢谢你

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Please go up one floor from here and go to the bleak Guyang Palace.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
请从这里上去一层，前往荒凉的龟阳宫。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
And please kill 100 monsters there, regardless of type.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
并且请在那里击杀100只魔物，不限种类。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'll be waiting for you here. Have a safe trip!!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我会在这里等你。一路顺风！！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
You're not fit to do research right now.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你现在不适合做研究。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I think it will be fine by tomorrow, can you come back after tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我想明天应该就没问题了，你能明天之后再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello, you are the only one who can help me...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你好，你是唯一能帮我的人...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
What we need to do is the same as last time...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我们要做的和上次一样...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Are you going to help me with the illusion investigation again?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你要再次帮我进行<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Aigoo...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Sob.....
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
呜...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Oops... Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
哎呀...谢谢你...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Go to the bleak archery and kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
去荒凉的射箭场，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Then be careful...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
然后小心点...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Destroy 100 monsters of any type in the bleak Archery.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
在荒凉的射箭场击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
You came home safely.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你安全回来了。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Uh... You took it down a lot faster than I expected.. You... you were a master??
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
呃...你完成得比我预想的快多了...你...你是高手吗？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
That should make the rest of the work easier.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
这样剩下的工作应该会轻松多了。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Thank you~ Thank you for your hard work!!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
谢谢~ 谢谢你的辛勤工作！！

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I am Sheshin belonging to the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我是隶属于幻觉调查队的谢辛。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I thought my fighting power would be enough to investigate here... but I guess I made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我以为凭我的实力足以在这里进行调查...但我似乎判断失误了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
这里的魔物比我预想的要强大得多。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Ah... I'm really proud of myself... but I need help... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
啊...我真的很自豪...但我需要帮助...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Adventurer hasn't joined the Illusion Investigation Team yet.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
冒险者还没有加入幻觉调查队。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Would you like to join the Illusionary Investigation Team? Wouldn't it be exciting to explore unknown phenomena?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
你想加入幻觉调查队吗？探索未知的现象不是很刺激吗？

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
If you would like to sign up, please go see Commander <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
如果你想报名，请去普隆德拉找指挥官 乔尔。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I am Sheshin belonging to the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我是隶属于幻觉调查队的谢辛。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I was active as a member of the Continental Guard in the past. At that time, I was tasked with exploring the dimensional rift created by the power of the demon king Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我过去曾是大陆卫兵的一员。当时，我负责探索由魔王莫洛克的魔力所创造的空间裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I was guessing to some extent that the illusions appearing everywhere had something to do with the power of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我推测到处出现的幻觉与空间裂缝的力量有关。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
It has been officially announced by Commander Joel that the Illusion is a phenomenon caused by a dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
指挥官 乔尔已经正式宣布，幻觉是由空间裂缝引起的现象。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
And soon a new illusion was discovered, yes... right here
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
很快，人们又发现了一种新的幻觉，是的...就在这里

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I joined the Illusion Investigation Team because I wanted to see it with my own eyes, and now I am here.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我加入幻觉调查队是因为我想亲眼看看，所以现在我就在这里。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
But I ran into a little problem...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
但我遇到了一点麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I thought my fighting power would be enough to investigate here... but I guess I made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我以为凭我的实力足以在这里进行调查...但我似乎判断失误了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
这里的魔物比我预想的要强大得多。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Ah... I really hurt my pride... but I need help...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
啊...我的自尊心受挫了...但我需要帮助...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Hmm... I think it's possible enough for you as an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
嗯...我觉得以你作为冒险者的实力，应该完全没问题...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I feel that you have much more power than me.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我感觉你比我强大得多。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Would you like to help me investigate the illusions in this sector?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
你愿意帮我调查这个区域的幻觉吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
This must be a good opportunity for adventurers...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
这对冒险者来说一定是个好机会...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
很好。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Please kill 100 monsters of any type located inside here.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
请在这里消灭100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Then, please travel carefully without getting hurt.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
那么，请小心行动，不要受伤。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
You don't have to do any more research today.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
今天不需要再进行研究了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Can you come back tomorrow if you want?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
如果你愿意，明天可以再来。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Welcome, you're here to help investigate the illusion, right?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
欢迎，你是来协助调查<黑暗搜集者>幻觉现象的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
You can do the same thing as last time.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
你可以像上次那样做。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
如果你能消灭100只任意种类的魔物，你愿意参与吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
It's a pity, it's sad that I still lack strength.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
真遗憾，可惜我实力还不够。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
很好。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Then, please travel carefully without getting hurt.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
那么，请小心行动，不要受伤。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
消灭100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I see... you finished quickly and came back.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
原来如此...你很快完成了任务并回来了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I need to investigate further to see if the phenomenon here is also affected by the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我需要进一步调查，看看这里的现象是否也受到了次元裂缝的影响。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I'll do the work myself from now on.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
接下来的工作由我自己来做。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Thank you so much for your help
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
非常感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
This is Cassis of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我是<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队的卡西斯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
虽然这里到处都是魔物，但我在这里依然感觉很安心。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I heard that one of the investigators is coming to help... is that you?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我听说有一位调查员要来帮忙...是你吗？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Oh, that's not true. You're not a member of the investigation team... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
哦，不是。你不是调查队的成员...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Would you like to join the Illusionary Investigation Team too? Would you like to investigate strange phenomena?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你想加入<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队吗？你想调查这些奇怪的现象吗？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
If you don't mind, please apply for membership with the Commander <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera and come!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
如果不介意的话，请去普隆德拉找指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申请入队，然后过来吧！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
This is Cassis of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我是<黑暗搜集者>幻觉调查队的卡西斯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
虽然这里到处都是魔物，但我在这里依然感觉很安心。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I don't like to get involved with people. Before I joined the investigation team, I ran a shop in Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我不喜欢和人打交道。在加入调查队之前，我在普隆德拉开过一家店...

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I don't like the feeling of being crowded, so it was hard to bear... I guess meeting a lot of people was stressful for my personality.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我不喜欢被人群包围的感觉，所以很难忍受...我想，对于我的性格来说，接触很多人是一种压力。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here, at least the monsters don't talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
虽然这里到处都是魔物，但我在这里依然感觉很安心，至少魔物不会跟我说话。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Ummm, by the way, I heard that one of the investigators is coming to help... I guess that's you?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
嗯，对了，我听说有一位调查员要来帮忙...我想那就是你吧？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Have you heard the general information from Captain Joel? You just need to display your fighting power without hesitation!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你从乔尔船长那里听到一般情况了吗？你只需要毫不迟疑地展示你的战斗力！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你想参与这个地方的调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Uh, then who the hell is the investigative team coming...?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
呃，那调查队的人到底是谁啊...

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Okay, thank you
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
好的，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type that exist here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
只要在这里击杀100只任意种类的魔物即可。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Then good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
那么，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Today's investigation is complete.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
今天的调查结束了。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
It would be nice if you could come tomorrow too... Please stop by if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
如果你明天也能来就好了...如果有空的话，请过来看看。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好，你今天来帮忙调查吗？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
The content is the same as last time.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
内容和上次一样。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
如果你击杀100只任意种类的魔物，你想参与吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
It would be nice if you could help me today...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
如果你今天能帮我就好了...

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我喜欢！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
进入后，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
那么，小心点！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Welcome, you're done!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
欢迎回来，你完成了！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
You've worked really hard. Are there any injuries anywhere?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你辛苦了。身上有没有受伤？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Leave the rest to me. Thanks
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
剩下的交给我吧。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I need help with my research work, so I'm looking for a suitable helper.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我的研究工作需要帮忙，所以正在寻找合适的助手。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
You're not the right person yet, sorry.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
抱歉，你似乎还不合适。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff== This is a level 180 or higher quest. ==^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff== 这是一个180级或以上的任务。 ==^000000

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I am Lista who is active in the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我是利斯特，隶属于<黑暗搜集者>调查队。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
It's been a while since I came down to the deep sea with Master.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
自从和师父一起潜入深海以来，已经过了很久了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm always working hard, but I don't think Master still approves of me.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我一直很努力，但我觉得师父还是不太认可我。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Just in time, the Illusion Investigation Team said they needed to investigate the deep sea here, so I quickly applied.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
正好，<黑暗搜集者>调查队说需要调查这里的深海，我就赶紧报名了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm sure Master would be happy if we could get even a little bit more information about the deep sea here as part of the investigation team!!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
如果我们能作为调查队的一员，哪怕只多获得一点关于这里深海的情报，师父一定会很高兴的！！！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Would you like to come with me?
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你愿意和我一起去吗？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Uh, but you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
呃，但你还没有加入调查队呢。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
请向普隆德拉的指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申请入队，然后过来！！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I am Lista who is active in the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我是利斯特，隶属于<黑暗搜集者>调查队。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
It's been a while since I came down to the deep sea with Master.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
自从和师父一起潜入深海以来，已经过了很久了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm always working hard, but I don't think Master still approves of me.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我一直很努力，但我觉得师父还是不太认可我。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Just in time, the Illusion Investigation Team said they needed to investigate the deep sea here, so I quickly applied.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
正好，<黑暗搜集者>调查队说需要调查这里的深海，我就赶紧报名了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm sure Master would be happy if we could get even a little bit more information about the deep sea here as part of the investigation team!!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
如果我们能作为调查队的一员，哪怕只多获得一点关于这里深海的情报，师父一定会很高兴的！！！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I was anxiously waiting for a member to help me with the investigation, and it went really well~
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我一直焦急地等待有成员来协助调查，结果非常顺利~

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Would you like to participate in this deep sea investigation?
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你愿意参加这次深海调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm neglected like this... It's wrong to be acknowledged by Master...
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我像这样被忽视...被师父认可才是对的...

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Oh, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
哦，谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Go down to the lower level dungeon of the Abyssal Undersea Cave and defeat 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
请前往深渊海底洞窟的下层迷宫，
击败任意种类的100只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
那么，请小心！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Let's finish here for today.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
今天就到这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I should be able to get back to work tomorrow, could you talk to me again then??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我明天应该就能恢复工作了，
到时候能再来找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello, would you like to do some research with me today??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好，今天愿意和我一起做一些研究吗？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Just do what you did last time!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
就按上次那样做吧！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
只要击败任意种类的100只魔物，
你愿意参与吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参与

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参与

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Today... I... incompetent... disciple...
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
今天...我...这个无能的...弟子...

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Good! Got it
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
很好！明白了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Go down to the lower level of the Abyssal Undersea Cave and kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
请前往深渊海底洞窟的下层，
击败任意种类的100只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
那么，请小心！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
击败任意种类的100只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
How was it? Are the monsters on the lower levels really strong??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
感觉如何？下层的魔物真的很强吗？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
You worked hard... Then I'll have to go down carefully.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
辛苦了...那我得小心地下去了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'll do the rest, thank you so much!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
剩下的交给我吧，感谢您！
